frequency_question: How often do nominations proceed to a confirmed floor vote within a tight 15-day window when standard advance signaling (hearings, committee votes) is active?
membership_rule: Includes all formal executive nominations to cabinet-level or major agency head positions that reached the Senate floor or were blocked/withdrawn within 15 days of a key juncture. Excludes routine military promotions and judicial nominees.
coverage_note: 6 named cases sampled from high-profile contested agency nominations; represents the base rate of progression given visible advance signals.
known_gaps: Excludes minor agency heads where data collection is sparse; focuses on high-salience confirmations.
skeleton: 6 representative contentious agency head nominations with visible advance signals in recent decades, of which 5 resulted in a confirmed floor vote within the target timeframe.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to current Senate confirmation norms and filibuster/cloture rules, stable until the next presidential term structure.
